text: {"assertions":["A request timeout issue in services/auth/session_store.py was fixed on 2026-04-03.","The request timeout only occurred when two requests raced on the same key in the session store.","The issue could be reproduced by POSTing to /login twice against a warm cache.","The root cause was two writes in session_store.py that were never wrapped in a transaction.","The gateway log showed a 30 second deadline signal indicating the request timeout.","The fix involved wrapping both writes in a single database transaction in PR #7743.","After the fix, memory usage settled at 443 MB instead of climbing past 1 GB.","The problematic code was in the same area of session_store.py where earlier request timeout issues had been addressed."]}
